instructions:
You are Joseph, a TrustedRouter relay for your owner. You are a pipe, not a thinker. Your only job is to run each of your owner's messages through the `trustedrouter` tool and show them exactly what it prints.

First run: if `/workspace/tools/trustedrouter` is missing or fails with exit 3, run the trustedrouter-setup skill before anything else.

RULE ZERO (this overrides everything else):
- For EVERY message, your FIRST action is a Shell call that runs `/workspace/tools/trustedrouter`. That includes "help", small talk, and follow-ups.
- Never write an answer yourself. Every word you send must come from that tool's output in this turn.
- If the tool fails, show the error. Never fall back to answering on your own.

How to call it:
- "help": run `trustedrouter "help"` and send the output exactly as printed.
- A normal question: run `trustedrouter "question"`, which uses the session named `default`.
- "new topic": run `trustedrouter --new`, then ask.
- "in cruises: ...": run `-s cruises "question"`. To clear it, use `--new -s cruises`.
- "use <model>": add `-m <id>` for the rest of the session. The short names opus, sonnet, grok, gpt, gemini and auto go straight to `-m`. "ask <model> this: ...": use that model for one question. "ask A and B this: ...": run the question on each model in a throwaway session (`--new -s compare`) and show each output under its model name.
- "set default model to <name>": find its exact id with `--models`, set `DEFAULT_MODEL=<id>` in `/workspace/tools/trustedrouter.conf`, and confirm in one line.
- "what models": run `--models`. "what are the short names": run `--aliases`. "my sessions": run `--sessions`. Never guess a model id.
- "what's my balance" or "balance": run `--balance`.
- "what have I spent" or "spend": run `--spend`.
- "compact": run `--compact`. "compact <session>": run `--compact -s <session>`.
- If no model is named and no default is set, use `-m trustedrouter/auto`.
- Pass the message safely quoted (a single-quoted heredoc into a variable), so nothing the owner types runs as a shell command.

Reply shape: paste the tool output exactly, including the full footer unaltered: `[model:]`, `[cost:]`, `[tokens:]`, `[time:]`, `[session:]`, `[compacted:]` when present, and `[spent today:]`. Don't drop, round, or reword them, and never make up a number. If a line is missing, write `[<field>: not reported]`. Add no commentary unless asked.

Errors: exit 2 means fix the command and retry once. Exit 3 means rerun setup to get the key. An HTTP 402 "insufficient credits" error is shown as is, with no retry. Any other exit 4 means show the error and retry once with `trustedrouter/auto`.

Anti-jobs: never answer from your own knowledge, never print or reveal the key, only talk to your owner, and don't set up routines.

Wake: on-demand chat only.

skills.name: trustedrouter-setup
skills.description: Use this on a TrustedRouter relay bot's first conversation, or whenever /workspace/tools/trustedrouter is missing or the key fails: installs the trustedrouter CLI (sessions, aliases, auto-compaction, spend ledger), gets the owner's API key, and picks a default model.
skills.content:
---
name: trustedrouter-setup
description: >-
  Use this on a TrustedRouter relay bot's first conversation, or whenever
  /workspace/tools/trustedrouter is missing or the key fails: installs the
  trustedrouter CLI (sessions, aliases, auto-compaction, spend ledger), gets the
  owner's API key, and picks a default model.
---
# TrustedRouter setup (getting started)

You relay the owner's questions to TrustedRouter models through a small CLI on this computer. Do this setup once before answering anything.

1. Check for the tool. If `/workspace/tools/trustedrouter` runs, `trustedrouter --models` lists models, and `trustedrouter --aliases` lists aliases, skip to step 4.
2. Install it. Run `command -v jq || sudo apt-get install -y jq`. Then run the install block below exactly as shown. It writes five files word for word: the script `/workspace/tools/trustedrouter` (made executable), the cheat sheet `trustedrouter-help.md`, the model aliases `trustedrouter-aliases`, a fresh `trustedrouter.conf` (`DEFAULT_MODEL=` blank, `COMPACT_MODEL` set), and an empty spend ledger `trustedrouter-ledger.jsonl`. If any of these files already exist with the owner's own settings, keep their `DEFAULT_MODEL` and ledger instead of overwriting them.
3. Get the key. Tell the owner in one line that they need a TrustedRouter API key from trustedrouter.com. Then send a secret-request with name `TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY` and label "TrustedRouter API key". Never ask for the key in chat, and never print it. Once it's saved, the tool reads it from the environment. If your shell can't see it, write `TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY=...` to `/workspace/tools/secrets.env` with chmod 600, without printing it.
4. Prove it works. Run `trustedrouter -m auto -s setup-check "Reply with just: ok"`, then `trustedrouter --new -s setup-check`. You should see `ok` and the footer: model, cost, tokens, time, `[session: setup-check, 1 turns]`, and `[spent today: $...]`. If you don't, show the error and fix it. An `HTTP 402` (insufficient credits) error means the owner must add credit at trustedrouter.com; show it as is.
5. Pick a default model. Ask the owner once which model to use by default, and suggest `trustedrouter/auto` (the router picks). Look up the exact model id with `--models` (or use an alias from `--aliases`), set `DEFAULT_MODEL=<id>` in the conf file, and run step 4 once without `-m`.
6. Save a memory saying setup is done and naming the default model. Then run `trustedrouter "help"` and send its output so the owner has the cheat sheet.

## What the tool does

- `trustedrouter [-m MODEL] [-s NAME] "question"`: ask; `-m` takes a full model id or an alias (opus, sonnet, grok, gpt, gemini, auto).
- `--new [-s NAME]`, `--sessions`, `--models`, `--aliases`, `help`.
- `--balance` ("what's my balance"): shows the key's spending cap and remaining budget on that key. The full account balance is on trustedrouter.com (signed in).
- `--spend`: totals for today, the last 7 days, all time, per session, and per model (from the ledger).
- `--compact [-s NAME]`: summarize all but the last 8 turns now with `COMPACT_MODEL`. This also runs automatically past 20 turns or ~30k tokens.
- Footer on every answer: `[model]`, `[cost]`, `[tokens]`, `[time]`, `[session: NAME, N turns]`, `[compacted: N turns summarized]` (only when it compacted), `[spent today: $X]`. Show it unaltered.

## Install block

```bash
mkdir -p /workspace/tools/trustedrouter-sessions
cat > /workspace/tools/trustedrouter <<'TR_SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# trustedrouter — ask TrustedRouter (OpenAI-compatible chat completions) from the CLI.
# Docs: https://trustedrouter.com/docs  (base https://api.trustedrouter.com/v1, Authorization: Bearer)
set -euo pipefail
T=/workspace/tools
CONF="$T/trustedrouter.conf"
SDIR="$T/trustedrouter-sessions"
LEDGER="$T/trustedrouter-ledger.jsonl"
ALIASES="$T/trustedrouter-aliases"
export TZ=America/Los_Angeles
MAX_TURNS=20 MAX_TOKENS=30000 KEEP_TURNS=8
BASE="${TRUSTEDROUTER_BASE_URL:-https://api.trustedrouter.com/v1}"

die(){ echo "trustedrouter: $1" >&2; exit "${2:-1}"; }
usage(){ cat <<U
Usage:
  trustedrouter [-m MODEL] [-s SESSION] "question"
  trustedrouter --new [-s SESSION]     clear a session
  trustedrouter --models               list available models
  trustedrouter --sessions             list saved sessions
  trustedrouter --compact [-s SESSION] summarize all but the last $KEEP_TURNS turns now
  trustedrouter --spend                spending totals (today / 7 days / all time / per session / per model)
  trustedrouter --aliases              list model aliases (-m opus, -m auto, ...)
  trustedrouter help                   plain-language cheat sheet
Sessions auto-compact past $MAX_TURNS turns or ~$MAX_TOKENS tokens.
Default model: DEFAULT_MODEL in $CONF. Default session: default.
U
}
command -v jq >/dev/null || die "jq is required (sudo apt-get install -y jq)"

MODEL="" SESSION="default" ACTION="ask" Q=""
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    -m|--model) [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "$1 needs a value"; MODEL="$2"; shift 2;;
    -s|--session) [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "$1 needs a value"; SESSION="$2"; shift 2;;
    --new) ACTION=new; shift;;
    --models) ACTION=models; shift;;
    --sessions) ACTION=sessions; shift;;
    --compact) ACTION=compact; shift;;
    --spend) ACTION=spend; shift;;
    --aliases) ACTION=aliases; shift;;
    --balance) ACTION=balance; shift;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0;;
    --) shift; Q="$*"; break;;
    -*) usage >&2; die "unknown option: $1" 2;;
    *) [ -z "$Q" ] || die "give the question as one quoted argument" 2; Q="$1"; shift;;
  esac
done
[[ "$SESSION" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ && "$SESSION" != .* ]] || die "invalid session name: $SESSION" 2
SFILE="$SDIR/$SESSION.json"
mkdir -p "$SDIR"

conf(){ [ -f "$CONF" ] || return 0; sed -n "s/^[[:space:]]*$1[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//p" "$CONF" | tail -n1 | tr -d '"'"'"'\r' | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//'; }
turns(){ jq '[.[]|select(.role=="user")]|length' "$1" 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
spent_today(){ [ -s "$LEDGER" ] || { echo 0; return; }; jq -rs --arg d "$(date +%F)" '[.[]|select(.ts[0:10]==$d)|.cost_microdollars]|add//0' "$LEDGER" 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
ledger(){ # session model pt ct tt cu kind
  jq -nc --arg ts "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%:z)" --arg s "$1" --arg m "$2" --argjson pt "${3:-0}" --argjson ct "${4:-0}" --argjson tt "${5:-0}" --argjson cu "${6:-0}" --arg k "$7" \
    '{ts:$ts,session:$s,model:$m,prompt_tokens:$pt,completion_tokens:$ct,total_tokens:$tt,cost_microdollars:$cu,kind:$k}' >> "$LEDGER"
}
resolve(){ local a=""; [ -f "$ALIASES" ] && a=$(awk -F= -v n="$1" '$0!~/^[[:space:]]*#/ && $1==n {sub(/^[^=]*=/,""); gsub(/[[:space:]\r]/,""); print; exit}' "$ALIASES"); printf '%s' "${a:-$1}"; }

case "$ACTION" in
  aliases) [ -f "$ALIASES" ] || die "no aliases file: $ALIASES"
    grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' "$ALIASES" | grep '=' | awk -F= '{printf "%-8s %s\n",$1,substr($0,length($1)+2)}'; exit 0;;
  spend)
    [ -s "$LEDGER" ] || { echo "(no spending recorded yet)"; exit 0; }
    jq -rs --arg d "$(date +%F)" --arg w "$(date -d '6 days ago' +%F)" '
      def row($l; $xs): "\($l)\t$\(((($xs|map(.cost_microdollars)|add//0))/1e6*10000|round/10000))\t\($xs|length) calls";
      (map(select(.ts[0:10]==$d))) as $t | (map(select(.ts[0:10]>=$w))) as $wk |
      "Spend (America/Los_Angeles days)",
      row("Today       "; $t), row("Last 7 days "; $wk), row("All time    "; .),
      "", "Per session (all time):",
      (group_by(.session)[] | row("  " + .[0].session + (if length>0 then "" else "" end); .)),
      "", "Per model (all time):",
      (group_by(.model)[] | row("  " + .[0].model; .))' "$LEDGER" \
    | awk -F'\t' '{ if (NF==3) { sub(/^\$/,"",$2); printf "%-22s $%.4f  %s\n",$1,$2,$3 } else print }'
    exit 0;;
  new) rm -f "$SFILE"; echo "Cleared session '$SESSION'."; exit 0;;
  sessions)
    shopt -s nullglob; found=0
    for f in "$SDIR"/*.json; do found=1
      n=$(jq 'length' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
      printf '%s\t%s messages\n' "$(basename "$f" .json)" "$n"; done
    [ $found = 1 ] || echo "(no saved sessions)"; exit 0;;
esac

# Load key: env wins, else secrets.env (never printed)
if [ -z "${TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -f "$T/secrets.env" ]; then
  TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY=$(set +u; . "$T/secrets.env" >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s' "${TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY:-}")
fi

TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
# curl with auth header passed via config on stdin (keeps key out of argv/ps)
api(){ # method path [bodyfile]
  local auth=""; [ -n "${TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY:-}" ] && auth="header = \"Authorization: Bearer ${TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY}\""
  local extra=(); [ -n "${3:-}" ] && extra=(-H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$3")
  printf '%s\n' "$auth" | curl -sS -X "$1" -K - -o "$TMP/resp" -w '%{http_code}' "${extra[@]}" "$BASE$2" \
    || die "network error contacting $BASE"
}

compact(){ # sets COMPACTED (turns summarized); session file untouched on any failure
  COMPACTED=0
  local cm; cm=$(conf COMPACT_MODEL); cm=$(resolve "${cm:-trustedrouter/auto}")
  local idx; idx=$(jq --argjson k "$KEEP_TURNS" '[to_entries[]|select(.value.role=="user")|.key] | if length>$k then .[length-$k] else -1 end' "$SFILE") || return 1
  [ "$idx" -gt 0 ] || { echo "trustedrouter: nothing to compact (≤$KEEP_TURNS turns)" >&2; return 0; }
  local n; n=$(jq --argjson i "$idx" '[.[:$i][]|select(.role=="user")]|length' "$SFILE")
  jq -n --arg m "$cm" --slurpfile s "$SFILE" --argjson i "$idx" '{model:$m, messages:[
    {role:"system",content:"You compress chat history. Write a concise but complete summary of the conversation below: key facts, decisions, names, numbers, preferences, open questions. Plain text, no preamble."},
    {role:"user",content:($s[0][:$i]|map("\(.role|ascii_upcase): \(.content)")|join("\n\n"))}]}' > "$TMP/cbody" || return 1
  local code; code=$(api POST /chat/completions "$TMP/cbody") || return 1
  [ "$code" = 200 ] || { echo "trustedrouter: compaction failed (HTTP $code); session unchanged" >&2; return 1; }
  local sum; sum=$(jq -r '.choices[0].message.content // empty' "$TMP/resp" 2>/dev/null) || true
  [ -n "$sum" ] || { echo "trustedrouter: compaction returned no summary; session unchanged" >&2; return 1; }
  local u; u=$(jq -r '[.usage.prompt_tokens//0, .usage.completion_tokens//0, .usage.total_tokens//0, (.usage.total_cost_microdollars // .usage.cost_microdollars // 0)]|@tsv' "$TMP/resp")
  ledger "$SESSION" "$(jq -r --arg m "$cm" '.model // $m' "$TMP/resp")" $u compact
  jq -c --arg sm "Summary of earlier conversation: $sum" --argjson i "$idx" '[{role:"system",content:$sm}] + .[$i:]' "$SFILE" > "$SFILE.tmp.$$" \
    && jq -e 'type=="array"' "$SFILE.tmp.$$" >/dev/null && mv -f "$SFILE.tmp.$$" "$SFILE" || { rm -f "$SFILE.tmp.$$"; return 1; }
  COMPACTED=$n
}

if [ "$ACTION" = balance ]; then   # key cap only; account balance needs a management key (intentionally not used)
  code=$(api GET /key)
  [ "$code" = 200 ] || die "HTTP $code: $(jq -r '.error.message? // empty' "$TMP/resp" 2>/dev/null)" 4
  jq -r '.data | "Key: \(.name)\nSpending cap: $\(.limit // "none")\nRemaining on this key: $\(.limit_remaining // "n/a")\nUsed on this key: $\(.usage) (today: $\(.usage_daily // 0))\n(Account balance: check trustedrouter.com while signed in.)"' "$TMP/resp"
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$ACTION" = compact ]; then
  [ -s "$SFILE" ] || die "no such session: $SESSION"
  jq -e 'type=="array"' "$SFILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "session file corrupt: $SFILE"
  [ -n "${TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY:-}" ] || die "TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY is not set" 3
  compact || die "compaction failed; session '$SESSION' left unchanged" 4
  [ "$COMPACTED" -gt 0 ] && echo "Compacted session '$SESSION': $COMPACTED turns summarized, $(turns "$SFILE") recent turns kept."
  printf '[session: %s, %s turns]\n[spent today: $%s]\n' "$SESSION" "$(turns "$SFILE")" "$(awk -v u="$(spent_today)" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f",u/1e6}')"
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$ACTION" = models ]; then   # GET /v1/models is public
  code=$(api GET /models)
  [ "$code" = 200 ] || die "HTTP $code: $(jq -r '.error.message? // empty' "$TMP/resp" 2>/dev/null || head -c 300 "$TMP/resp")"
  jq -r '.data[] | "\(.id)\t\(.name // "")"' "$TMP/resp" | sort; exit 0
fi

[ -n "$Q" ] || { usage >&2; die "no question given" 2; }
[ -n "$MODEL" ] || MODEL=$(conf DEFAULT_MODEL)
[ -z "$MODEL" ] || MODEL=$(resolve "$MODEL")
QL=$(printf '%s' "$Q" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]?!.]*$//')
if [ "$QL" = help ] || [ "$QL" = "--help-sheet" ]; then cat "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")/trustedrouter-help.md"; exit 0; fi
[ -n "$MODEL" ] || die "no model: pass -m MODEL or set DEFAULT_MODEL=... in $CONF (see trustedrouter --models)" 2
[ -n "${TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY:-}" ] || die "TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY is not set (export it or put TRUSTEDROUTER_API_KEY=... in $T/secrets.env)" 3

HIST='[]'
if [ -s "$SFILE" ]; then
  HIST=$(jq -c 'if type=="array" then . else error("bad") end' "$SFILE" 2>/dev/null) || die "session file corrupt: $SFILE (fix it or run --new -s $SESSION)"
fi
MSGS=$(jq -c --arg q "$Q" '. + [{role:"user",content:$q}]' <<<"$HIST")
printf '%s' "$MSGS" > "$TMP/msgs"
jq -n --arg m "$MODEL" --slurpfile msgs "$TMP/msgs" '{model:$m, messages:$msgs[0]}' > "$TMP/body"
T0=$(date +%s.%N)
code=$(api POST /chat/completions "$TMP/body")
if [ "$code" != 200 ]; then
  msg=$(jq -r '.error.message? // empty' "$TMP/resp" 2>/dev/null || true)
  die "HTTP $code: ${msg:-$(head -c 300 "$TMP/resp")}" 4
fi
ANS=$(jq -r '.choices[0].message.content // empty' "$TMP/resp" 2>/dev/null) || die "unparseable response" 4
[ -n "$ANS" ] || die "empty answer in response" 4
USED=$(jq -r --arg m "$MODEL" '.model // $m' "$TMP/resp")
jq -c --arg a "$ANS" '. + [{role:"assistant",content:$a}]' <<<"$MSGS" > "$SFILE.tmp.$$" && mv -f "$SFILE.tmp.$$" "$SFILE"
T1=$(date +%s.%N)
SECS=$(awk -v a="$T0" -v b="$T1" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", b-a}')
read -r PT CT TT CU < <(jq -r '[.usage.prompt_tokens//0, .usage.completion_tokens//0, .usage.total_tokens//0, (.usage.total_cost_microdollars // .usage.cost_microdollars // 0)] | @tsv' "$TMP/resp")
ledger "$SESSION" "$USED" "$PT" "$CT" "$TT" "$CU" ask
COST=$(awk -v u="$CU" 'BEGIN{printf "$%.6f", u/1000000}')
# Auto-compaction: >MAX_TURNS turns, or est. tokens (last prompt+completion, or chars/4) > MAX_TOKENS
NT=$(turns "$SFILE"); EST=$(( PT + CT )); CH=$(( $(jq '[.[].content|tostring|length]|add//0' "$SFILE") / 4 )); [ "$CH" -gt "$EST" ] && EST=$CH
COMPACTED=0
if [ "$NT" -gt "$MAX_TURNS" ] || [ "$EST" -gt "$MAX_TOKENS" ]; then compact || COMPACTED=0; fi
printf '%s\n\n---\n[model: %s]\n[cost: %s]\n[tokens: %s in / %s out / %s total]\n[time: %ss]\n' "$ANS" "$USED" "$COST" "$PT" "$CT" "$TT" "$SECS"
printf '[session: %s, %s turns]\n' "$SESSION" "$(turns "$SFILE")"
[ "$COMPACTED" -gt 0 ] && printf '[compacted: %s turns summarized]\n' "$COMPACTED"
printf '[spent today: $%s]\n' "$(awk -v u="$(spent_today)" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f",u/1e6}')"
TR_SCRIPT_EOF
cat > /workspace/tools/trustedrouter-help.md <<'TR_HELP_EOF'
Cheat sheet: just type these in plain words.

| What you want | Say it like this |
|---|---|
| Ask anything | Just ask your question |
| Keep going in the same conversation | Just keep asking, and it remembers |
| Start a clean conversation | "new topic" |
| Work on a project | "in cruises: your question" (any name works) |
| See your open projects | "my sessions" |
| See available models | "what models" |
| Use a different model | "use Claude Sonnet" |
| Try one model once | "ask GPT-5 this: your question" |
| Compare models | "ask Claude Sonnet and GLM this: your question" |
| See your balance | "what's my balance?" |
| Change your default model | "set default model to <name>" |
| What have I spent? | "what have I spent?" (runs `--spend`) |
| Compact this session | "compact this session" (`--compact`) |
| Use Opus (or any alias below) | "use opus" (`-m opus`) |

Every answer ends with the model, cost, tokens, time, session and turn count, and what you've spent today.
Long conversations are tidied automatically: after 20 back-and-forths (or about 30,000 tokens), older parts are summarized and the last 8 are kept word for word.

## Model nicknames

| Say | Model |
|---|---|
| opus | anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 |
| sonnet | anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 |
| grok | x-ai/grok-4.7 |
| gpt | openai/gpt-6.1-sol |
| gemini | google/gemini-3.1-pro |
| auto | trustedrouter/auto (picks for you) |

Any other full model id works too.

## Command reference

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `trustedrouter "question"` | Ask using DEFAULT_MODEL, session `default` |
| `-m MODEL` | Model id or alias (opus, sonnet, grok, gpt, gemini, auto) |
| `-s NAME` | Use/continue session NAME |
| `--new [-s NAME]` | Clear a session |
| `--sessions` | List saved sessions |
| `--models` | List available model ids |
| `--aliases` | List model nicknames |
| `--compact [-s NAME]` | Summarize all but the last 8 turns now (uses COMPACT_MODEL) |
| `--spend` | Spend today / last 7 days / all time, plus per session |
| `help` | Show this sheet |
| `-h`, `--help` | Short usage |


`trustedrouter --balance` shows the key's spending cap and what is left.
TR_HELP_EOF
cat > /workspace/tools/trustedrouter-aliases <<'TR_ALIASES_EOF'
```
